Herbs & Spices

About This Category

Canonical culinary herbs and spices across four immutable groups: Fresh Herbs, Dried Herbs, Whole Spices, and Ground & Blended Spices.

The Herb & Spice Ontology catalogs canonical culinary herbs and spices used worldwide as ingredients. This domain models culinary ingredients, not botanical taxonomy.
